description.narrative: Appropriate knowledge products are produced using research, project knowledge, practices and learning.
By end of December 2021, an emergency ready network is achieved in the regional and national offices in at least 6 disaster-prone countries of Asia-Pacific through training and systemization.
By end of December 2023, Global Emergency Fund (GEF) is allocated to implement rapid, effective, and inclusive humanitarian responses to natural disasters.

To prevent damage and loss to older people, their families, resources, and capital, by inclusive institutional preparedness and timely and effective emergency actions associated with natural disasters. Support will be provided to responses in multiple countries based on need. HelpAge provide Global Emergency Fund (GEF) to local humanitarian partners and CSOs to provide immediate emergency response towards small and medium invisible natural emergency crisis around the world. This a multi-country programme and we have partner activities in a number of countries including: South Sudan, Uganda, Zimbabwe and Yemen.
